references.read_scope: Official report landing page and existing repository source review

references.title: Renewable power generation costs in 2024

references.read_scope: Local original-report extraction: title/copyright and previously reviewed cost sections; official landing page returned HTTP 403 on this verification
references.finding: Published project-cost and performance aggregates are reused evidence, not original observations of this team.

title: A Model Predictive Control Approach to Microgrid Operation Optimization

references.title: Multicriteria diversity analysis

references.finding: Multicriteria energy-portfolio diversity has prior research. Our HHI identity is elementary and is not presented as a new diversity theory.

references.title: SMAA - Stochastic multiobjective acceptability analysis
references.author: Lahdelma, Hokkanen and Salminen
references.finding: Multiobjective acceptability analysis has prior research; the present work does not implement or claim to improve SMAA.

references.title: A Value for n-Person Games
references.author: L. S. Shapley
references.read_scope: Publisher-deposited metadata for the 1953 book chapter. RAND 1951 report page and PDF returned 403; not represented as inspected
references.finding: Shapley allocation is an established method; our complete permutation implementation is checked against efficiency, symmetry and dummy-player fixtures, not claimed as a new allocation algorithm.

references.author: Sidney Gathrid; Jeremy Wayland; Stuart Wayland; Ranjit Deshmukh; Grace C. Wu

references.title: Testing of detection tools for AI-generated text
references.author: Weber-Wulff and colleagues
references.read_scope: Author abstract and reported evaluation scope
references.finding: Detection reliability depends on tool and text setting; the paper does not justify assigning an authorship percentage to this repository.

references.title: GPT detectors are biased against non-native English writers
references.author: Liang and colleagues
references.read_scope: Original author abstract on arXiv v3; PMC URL returned a captcha page and was not used as article evidence
references.finding: False positives and distribution sensitivity are demonstrated for non-native English. Its numerical results cannot be transferred to Chinese energy papers.

references.title: Can AI-Generated Text be Reliably Detected?
references.author: Sadasivan and colleagues
references.read_scope: Author abstract on v4; robustness results are setting-dependent and are not used for detector evasion
references.finding: Detection has distribution-dependent limitations. This is not evidence that every detector is useless or that an undetected text is human-authored.
references.version_note: First preprint 2023; inspected version v4 posted 2025-01-17, page identifies TMLR publication

references.title: How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection
references.author: Guo and colleagues
references.read_scope: Author corpus description and detection scope
references.finding: HC3 includes Chinese and English answers, but those benchmark distributions do not calibrate mixed human/AI technical manuscripts in this project.

references.title: M4: Multi-generator, Multi-domain, and Multi-lingual Black-Box Machine-Generated Text Detection
references.author: Wang and colleagues
references.finding: Some detectors perform usefully in matched benchmark conditions, while transfer across generators/domains/languages must be tested; do not infer a local posterior without calibration.

references.title: C-HAT-Bench: Benchmarking Chinese AI-Text Detection Beyond Fully Generated Text
references.author: Qing Yang and colleagues
references.read_scope: Author preprint v1 abstract and submission metadata; no peer-review or full-text verification claimed
references.finding: Chinese collaborative writing changes detection behavior relative to fully generated text. A document classification score is not a measured percentage of who wrote each character.
